name: Microsoft Visual C++ v14 Redistributable (x64)
author: Microsoft Corporation
summary: The Microsoft Visual C++ v14 Redistributable Package (x64).
description: The Microsoft Visual C++ v14 Redistributable Package (x64) installs runtime components of Visual C++ Libraries required to run 64-bit applications developed with Visual C++ 2015, 2017, 2019, 2022 and 2026 on a computer that does not have Visual C++ 2015, 2017, 2019, 2022 and 2026 installed.

verification.label: Hashes copied from upstream package manifests (winget-pkgs, Homebrew cask). Not independently re-computed; signatures not checked.
